figs.name: orifice-plate-sizing-procedure-flowchart
figs.alt: orifice plate sizing procedure flowchart from flow and DP range to bore and beta checks
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the orifice plate sizing steps: fix flow and pipe ID, pick a DP range, solve ISO 5167 for the bore, then check beta and minimum bore.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Orifice plate sizing procedure flowchart</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Orifice Plate Sizing Step by Step</text>
<rect x="40" y="60" width="340" height="58" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="83.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Fix max flow, pipe ID D</text>
<text x="210.0" y="106.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and fluid density</text>
<rect x="40" y="140" width="340" height="58" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="163.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Pick a DP range</text>
<text x="210.0" y="186.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">about 2500 mmH2O</text>
<rect x="40" y="220" width="340" height="58" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="243.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Solve ISO 5167 equation</text>
<text x="210.0" y="266.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">for bore diameter d</text>
<rect x="40" y="300" width="340" height="58" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="323.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Beta ratio</text>
<text x="210.0" y="346.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">β = d ÷ D</text>
<line x1="210" y1="118" x2="210" y2="138" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="210" y1="198" x2="210" y2="218" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="210" y1="278" x2="210" y2="298" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="210" y1="358" x2="210" y2="375" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="210,375.0 360.0,430 210,485.0 60.0,430" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210" y="425.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">β in 0.1</text>
<text x="210" y="447.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">to 0.75?</text>
<polyline points="60,430 20,430 20,169 38,169" fill="none" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="42" y="418" font-size="17" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<line x1="360" y1="430" x2="428" y2="430" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="394" y="418" font-size="17" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="430" y="402" width="340" height="58" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="425.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5. Check d ≥ 12.5 mm</text>
<text x="600.0" y="448.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ISO, or 12.7 mm API</text>
<rect x="430" y="310" width="340" height="58" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="333.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6. Correct D and d to</text>
<text x="600.0" y="356.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">operating temperature</text>
<rect x="430" y="218" width="340" height="58" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="241.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">7. Confirm pressure loss</text>
<text x="600.0" y="264.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and straight pipe run</text>
<rect x="430" y="126" width="340" height="58" rx="10" fill="#b45309" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="149.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">8. Specify plate E, bevel</text>
<text x="600.0" y="172.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and sharp upstream edge</text>
<line x1="600" y1="402" x2="600" y2="370" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="600" y1="310" x2="600" y2="278" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="600" y1="218" x2="600" y2="186" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="505" width="730" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="405" y="532" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">qm = C ÷ √(1 − β⁴) × ε × (π/4) d² × √(2 ΔP ρ)</text>
<text x="405" y="556" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Preferred β 0.4 to 0.6 for accuracy and low pressure loss</text>
</svg>
